#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
long long int N, idx, top, rep, arr[500000], ans = INT_MAX, temp;

void f(long long int x, long long int s, long long int k, long long int kk) {
    if (s >= idx) return;
    if (x == 0) {
        printf("%d", s);
        exit(0);
    }
    while (k > x) { k /= 10; kk--; }
    f(0, s + ((k * 10 + 1) - x) + kk + 1, k * 10 + 1, kk + 1);
    long long int t = x / k;
    f((k * 10 + 1) - x, s + kk + 1, k, kk);
    f(x - (k * t), s + (kk * t), k, kk);
}

int main() {
    cin >> N;
    rep = 1;
    temp = 1;
    while (rep * 10 + 1 <= N) {
        rep = rep * 10 + 1;
        temp++;
    }
    idx = 0;
    while (idx < N) {
        f(N, 0, rep, temp);
        idx++;
    }
    if (ans == INT_MAX) ans = min(N, 11 - N + 2);
    printf("%lld", ans);
    return 0;
}
